decks.caption: For the days that get away from you: pick one thing that still matters and give it ten minutes. You can move the rest. #productivity #dailyroutine #gettingthingsdone

slides.text: the 10-minute reset for when your day goes off track
don't rewrite your whole to-do list.
pick the one thing that still matters today.
set a 10-minute timer. start with the rough version.
move the rest to tomorrow. today doesn't need a full comeback.

decks.caption: being 'that girl' is mostly doing the little things you said you'd do, on a normal day. start with two. #productivity #thatgirl #habits

slides.text: how to be the girl who actually follows through
stop building a routine for a version of you who wakes up at 5.
pick 2 things you can do on a normal Tuesday.
put your phone across the room for the first 20 minutes.
consistency looks kind of boring. that's the point.
